journeys.trigger: customer asks for current parcel status
journeys.definition_of_done: Current authoritative tracking evidence is communicated and the Case is safely closed without unsupported commitments.
journeys.recovery_path: create or continue human-owned Case and preserve the last authoritative evidence
acceptance: authoritative tracking fact is structured evidence
customer notification is a structured outcome
technical lookup success alone cannot close the Case
provider failure produces a visible retry or human handoff

journeys.trigger: customer reports delay or asks for delivery commitment
journeys.definition_of_done: Current tracking history and service commitment are evaluated, communicated and stable through the governed observation period.
journeys.recovery_path: keep the Case open or observed and route to delivery operations
acceptance: SLA uses the immutable Case policy revision and business calendar
observation period blocks premature closure
repeat contact and reopen are measured
customer receives the confirmed next step

journeys.trigger: customer requests an address or contact correction
journeys.definition_of_done: Identity and current parcel facts are verified, the governed correction is accepted or rejected, and the customer is notified.
journeys.recovery_path: mark repair required, prevent duplicate execution and retain human ownership
acceptance: identity verification is structured evidence
tool acceptance is distinct from operational completion
idempotency prevents duplicate correction
customer notification is required before safe closure

journeys.trigger: customer needs a governed delivery follow-up work order
journeys.definition_of_done: One non-duplicate work order is accepted, its provider receipt is recorded, and the customer receives the next step.
journeys.recovery_path: retain the same Case and idempotency key, schedule bounded retry or route to operations
acceptance: one action intent creates at most one external work order
queued and accepted states are not shown as business completion
dead jobs become repair-required operational evidence
customer is notified of the confirmed state

journeys.trigger: authoritative evidence shows repeated failed delivery attempts
journeys.definition_of_done: Attempt evidence, issue registration and permitted recovery action are complete, the customer is notified, and the Case remains observable or safely closes.
journeys.metric_denominator: failed-attempt Cases in the reporting window
journeys.recovery_path: route to delivery exceptions with preserved ownership, evidence and customer contact
acceptance: delivery attempts and issue registration are authoritative evidence
high-risk unresolved cases cannot safely close
human handoff uses the canonical HandoffRequest writer
reopen and repeat-contact signals remain visible in Control Tower
